newsitem.title: GERMANY: German GEA - plans unchanged 96 dividend.
newsitem.headline: German GEA - plans unchanged 96 dividend.

text.p: German process technology supplier GEA AG said on Monday that it planned to pay an unchanged dividend on 1996 earnings and expected a clear increase on 1997 profits after profits slipped last year.
The group said it plans to pay out 10 marks per share on ordinary shares and 11 marks per share for preference shares.
For the current business year, GEA said it expected to post "clearly improved" results as the group reaps the fruits of its consolidation programme which includes cost cuttings.
Turnover should grow by some five percent as measured on an adjusted basis, which would be unchanged on paper from last year's sales, the group said.
GEA also said results in the first four months of the year supported the outlook for stronger results for 1997.
The group reported a decline in its net profit to 105 million marks in 1996 from 110.7 million marks in 1995. Last year's sales totalled 4.31 billion marks, up from 1995's 4.05 billion marks.
